verdict.rationale: Mercury's built-in Command assistant answers questions about spend and trends grounded in account data, and bill pay automatically detects duplicate bills, so pieces of the story exist. However, nothing documents an agent that proactively monitors the ledger and flags spend anomalies or duplicate ledger transactions before close. The API and MCP layer that would let external agents do this are only promised as "soon," and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: proactive ledger anomaly monitoring/alerting, duplicate detection on ledger transactions (not just bills), shipped API/MCP for external agents, close-workflow integration, independent or hands-on corroboration
